findings.obs_text: In Gen 18:28 and Gen 18:30 find is the Lord's answer to Abraham's case: if he finds the number there, he will not destroy. In Luk 2:44 the parents, supposing the boy in the group, travel a day before they search for him, and in Joh 20:15 Mary, asked whom she seeks, takes Jesus for the gardener: the supposing delays or misdirects the seeking.
findings.grounds: they began to search for him

older.finding: In John 20:15 Jesus asks Mary 'whom are you seeking' (zeteo) — plain literal search for a missing person, squarely within the base gloss, no divergence.
older.reason: it states a face or use of the search words; the search collection owns it

older.finding: No other M-code characteristic co-occurs in this verse's role list at the home-cluster level; M03, M15, M72 appear on other words but are not this cluster's own home strongs, and no prior relational context exists to build on.
older.reason: it states how search works in a person; the search collection owns it

older.finding: The operation 'seeking' is initiated by Mary (addressed as 'you') and directed toward the missing body of Jesus ('whom') — Jesus as questioner surfaces the operation, but the seeker-party is Mary, the sought object is Jesus/his body.
older.reason: it states a face or use of the search words; the search collection owns it

older.finding: 'find' here only names a physical search or finding, a practical or judicial finding, a record search or reconnaissance; no inner-being operation is voiced by it.

findings.obs_text: In Gen 18:29 and Gen 18:30 do is the Lord's not doing what Abraham's case asks him to hold back. In Eze 18:14 the son of the case sees his father's sins and does not do likewise. In Rom 2:3 the one who judges does the same things and is asked if he supposes he escapes.
findings.grounds: he sees, and does not do likewise

findings.obs_text: In Eze 18:14 the prophet's case is of a son who sees all the sins his father did: the sins are what the son sees and turns from.
findings.grounds: sees all the sins that his father has done

findings.obs_text: In 2Sa 13:33 take is the setting of the heart on the report: the king is not to take it to heart so as to suppose all his sons dead. In Joh 20:15 Mary, taking Jesus for the gardener, offers to take the body away.
findings.grounds: so take it to heart as to suppose

findings.obs_text: In Luk 7:43 rightly is Jesus' verdict on Simon's view: the supposing is judged correct.
In Psa 41:7 the haters whisper together against the psalmist and devise the worst for him: the whispering is the speech that goes with the devising, both turned against him.
In Rom 2:3 judgment is God's, which the man who judges others is asked if he supposes he will escape: the false view is of escaping it.
